name: Life Goals & Mentoring
short: Weekly 1:1 sessions to set goals, build routines and confidence, and get more involved in your community.
seoTitle: Life Goals Mentoring Online: NDIS or Private
seoDescription: Weekly 1:1 life goals mentoring online: goals, routines, budgeting, confidence and community participation. NDIS (self or plan-managed) or private.
lede: One session a week, one person in your corner. We set small, clear goals together, you go and do them, and each week we look at what worked and what got in the way.
whoFor: Anyone who wants more independence, structure or confidence, including NDIS participants
People working towards a bigger goal (moving out, study, work, getting out more) who want help breaking it into steps
Families and support coordinators looking for a consistent, practical mentor
included: A weekly 1:1 session on Microsoft Teams
Goals you choose, set at a size you can actually do this week
Help with routines, budgeting, appointments and getting organised
Building confidence to join activities, groups and your local community
Written notes after every session: what you did, what's next
funding: Private clients: email for current rates. NDIS: funded through your plan if you're self-managed or plan-managed. Community Help Co is an unregistered NDIS provider, so we can't be paid from NDIA-managed (agency-managed) plans; we'll check with you and your plan manager which support category fits before we start.

name: Job Catalyst Sessions
short: Employment coaching: find the right roles, sharpen your resume, prepare for interviews and settle into a new job.
seoDescription: 1:1 job coaching online: the right roles, resume and cover letters, tailored applications, interview practice and settling into a new job. NDIS or private.
lede: Looking for work can be a lot. Job Catalyst Sessions break it into weekly steps: work out what kind of job suits you, get your applications right, and feel ready for the interview and the first weeks after.
whoFor: Job seekers who want a coach who actually follows through
NDIS participants with work goals in their plan
People returning to work after a break
included: Working out the roles that suit your strengths, needs and hours
A clear resume and a cover letter you can reuse
Interview practice and what to say about support needs (if anything)
Check-ins in the first weeks of a new job
funding: Private clients: email for current rates. NDIS: funded through your plan where your goals include work, for self-managed and plan-managed participants; we'll confirm the right support category with you and your plan manager first. Community Help Co is an unregistered NDIS provider.

name: Advocacy Support
short: Help to speak up and follow through with services, appointments and complaints.
seoTitle: Advocacy Support: Speak Up and Follow Through
seoDescription: Practical help to speak up and follow through: preparing for appointments, contacting services, tracking what was agreed and making complaints.
lede: Services can be hard to deal with on your own. We help you work out what you want to say, prepare for the call or meeting, and keep track of what happens next.
whoFor: People who find calls, forms and appointments stressful
People who feel they haven't been heard by a service
Families who want someone practical alongside them
included: Planning what to ask for before an appointment or call
Help writing emails and keeping a record of what was agreed
Support to make a complaint when something isn't right
funding: Usually part of your mentoring sessions and paid the same way: privately, or through NDIS for self-managed and plan-managed participants. This is practical, everyday advocacy, not legal advice.
